notes: "Avatar tower obby" names the genre outright, so Obby & Platformer leads with its genre-wide P6, and course-tower plus the Tower Obby preset follow directly from the word tower. I did not name Roleplay & Avatar Sim as a second genre even though the hook is wearing an outfit: that genre's whole table is town circulation and housing, none of which this build has, while Obby's own winner-zone already covers morphs and interactables, so nothing would have been gained. The two choice boxes are the prompt's headline feature and need somewhere to stand, so I placed them in social-hub as a small start area at the tower base rather than as obstacle-guess, which would have told the image model the wrong pick drops you when in fact both picks are valid. From the answers I took bright toon dressing, simple jump platforms over anything elaborate, and a compact tower that fits one frame, so the stacked climb stays P2 without needing decomposition into separate stacked sections.
